title: Nursery Rhymes
text:
Nursery rhymes are short songs and poems for children. Many people learn them when they are very young. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star is a famous nursery rhyme. Children like to sing it before they go to sleep.

Hickory Dickory Dock is another nursery rhyme. In this rhyme, a mouse runs up a clock. When the clock strikes one, the mouse runs down. Many children enjoy this funny song.

questions.text: What is Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star?
What runs up the clock in Hickory Dickory Dock?
Why are nursery rhymes useful for very young children?
options: They help children learn words and music

questions.text: Why is Hickory Dickory Dock probably fun for children?
options: A mouse does silly things in it
It is very long and boring

vocabulary.definition: a thing that shows the time
a small animal with a long tail

paragraph_translations: Wierszyki dziecięce to krótkie piosenki i wiersze dla dzieci. Wiele osób uczy się ich, kiedy są bardzo małe. „Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” to sławny wierszyk dziecięcy. Dzieci lubią go śpiewać przed snem.
„Hickory Dickory Dock” to kolejny wierszyk dziecięcy. W tym wierszu mysz wspina się po zegarze. Kiedy zegar wybija pierwszą, mysz zbiega na dół. Wiele dzieci lubi tę zabawną piosenkę.
